newsitem.title: USA: L.A. rail agency disciplines officials over costs.
newsitem.headline: L.A. rail agency disciplines officials over costs.

text.p: The Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority has disciplined two top rail project officials for failing to curb chronic cost overruns, according to a published report on Friday.
The officials were disciplined following release of a blistering audit of the authority's light rail line to Pasadena, the Los Angeles Times reported.

The audit found that the price of design and engineering work for the 13.6-mile rail line from Union Station to Pasadena had nearly doubled from a budgeted $47 million to an estimated $94 million, the Times said.
Project manager David Sievers and his deputy, Lynn Struthers, both received "letters of disciplinary action" last Friday, according to the Times report.
